_comment: The Cloudflare Worker proxy. Yahoo sends no CORS header, so a browser cannot read its chart API directly - this worker fetches it server-side and adds the header, which is what lets the terminal draw live intraday candles. Leave proxy empty and the site still works: stock pages fall back to the stored daily series.
_telegram_comment: Two channels, tested on a GitHub runner 17 Nov 2026. Both posted that day and have the web preview enabled. sureshsharma1 posts structured intraday calls with entry, SL and target, which makes them scoreable. way2laabh posts commentary and tickers.
